value: SRMA: Department of Homeland Security (CISA); Department of Commerce BIS (EAR; ICTS connected-vehicle rule); Department of Defense (for defense supply chain)
NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2.0 with NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3 (OT)

No binding sector-wide cyber regulation exists for critical manufacturing; CSF 2.0 + SP 800-82r3 is the federal reference baseline for IT/OT. Where the manufacturer is a DoD supplier, substitute NIST SP 800-171 R2 / CMMC Level 2 as the binding target.
Product designs / trade secrets; EAR-controlled technology; CUI (defense suppliers); Vehicle and telematics data; Supplier/BOM data
PLCs, robotics and CNC; MES and SCADA; PLM/CAD; ERP and supply-chain planning; Industrial IoT/historians; Vehicle telematics/OTA update infrastructure
Critical manufacturing is one of the explicit CIRCIA sector criteria, so once final, most NAICS 331/333/335/336 manufacturers would be covered regardless of size.
